title: hydrangea fistulosa
intro: Hydrangea fistulosa, commonly known as the mountain hydrangea, is a perennial flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of eastern Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese and Korean medicine, where it is valued for its ability to promote digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The health benefits of Hydrangea fistulosa include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Hydrangea fistulosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties.
